name: Agent Lee Real 3D Game Asset Standard
real3DRequirements: A real GLB, OBJ, or FBX asset must be produced or validated.
Neural Reconstruction requires a real local image-to-3D backend.
Procedural OBJ fallback cannot be labeled Neural Reconstruction.
Game-ready means asset loads, has geometry, has export path, and is validated for target profile.
Roblox, Unity, Unreal, WebXR profiles must be tracked separately.
Every 3D asset must write receipt with source image, prompt, output path, file size, vertex count, face count, and validation status.
truth: No fake 3D READY. If a neural backend is missing, status remains BLOCKED or CHECK_REQUIRED.
